newsitem.title: USA: Eckler to merge with Smart Choice.
newsitem.headline: Eckler to merge with Smart Choice.

text.p: Eckler Industries Inc Monday said it signed a definitive merger agreement to combine with Smart Choice Holdings Inc of Windemere, Fla.
Under the pact, Eckler will issue 6.5 million shares of its common stock in exchange for all of the common stock of Smart Choice.

The merger, which is expected to close in the next 10 days, is subject to several conditions including the completion of Smart Choice's planned acquisitions and the closing of the associated financing transactions.
Smart Choice Holdings is a privately held company that upon completion of the merger will be one of the first publicly held companies in the automobile dealership business.

The merger will result in Eckler's name to be changed to Smart Choice Holdings Inc. The new public company, which will be headquartered in Titusville, Fla., is expected to have sales in excess of $120 million in 1997.

The new public company will be reorganized into a holding company that will encompass four divisions: Corvette parts and accessories, new car sales, used car sales and insurance and auto finance. Eckler Industries is a leading supplier of Corvette parts and accessories with over 95,000 customers.
